findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "compare_saved_products" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_videos, product_scout, analyze_product · Private data: brief_to_blueprint · Public sink: trend_pulse, predict_virality, brief_to_blueprint · Destructive: analyze_account, watch_account, get_changes, find_viral_template, get_saved_research.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_videos, product_scout, analyze_product · Private data: brief_to_blueprint · Public sink: trend_pulse, predict_virality, brief_to_blueprint · Destructive: analyze_account, watch_account, get_changes, find_viral_template, get_saved_research

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "trend_pulse" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
